senses.gloss: m. (תרך) = טרכוס (v. טַרְכֵּשׁ), dresser, bracket, counter.
units: Y. Sabb. I, 2ᵈ top ת׳ שהוא עומד וכ׳ a tarkos (in front of a building) that stands in the public road … which is used to hand things from within to the street, and from the street to within.—[Ib. III, end, 6ᶜ bot.; Tanḥ. T’rumah, ed. Bub. 8, v. תְּרוֹנוֹס.]—Tosef. ib. XIV (XV), 2 תַּרְקוֹשׁ, v. טַרְכֵּשׁ.—Pl. תַּרְכּוֹסִים, תַּרְכּוֹסִין.

Kel. XXIV, 5 שלשה ת׳ של ספרין וכ׳ Ar. (ed. תרבוסין; Maim. Hilkhoth Kelim XXVII, 5 תרכ׳) there are three kinds of dressers (with regard to levitical cleanness): that of the barber shop, …, that at which people eat (v. Sm. Ant.3 Engl. ed. s. v. Abacus) …, and that on which olives are spread; [Maim.: a sort of leather chest].
